learning_outcomes.text: Recognize the Mechanical Engineering curriculum of Sakarya University Faculty of Engineering and the opportunities of the Faculty/Department.
Have knowledge about the mechanical engineering profession, its history, present, future, and its role in society.
Have knowledge about manufacturing methods in mechanical engineering.
Possess an understanding of professional and ethical responsibility.
Achieve closeness to the profession by sharing the experiences of graduates and colleagues.
Know about measurement and control topics, recognize the measuring instruments used.

syllabus_topics: Mechanical Engineering as a Profession. Definition of Engineer and Engineering
Energy and Machine. Dimensions, Units and Error
Unit analysis, explanation of unit conversions and related applications
Definition of measurement and control topics, introduction of measuring instruments used.
Introduction of calipers, micrometers, and comparators as dimension measuring instruments, and gauges as control instruments. Applications of reading measurements with calipers and micrometers.
Fasteners, Welding joints, Brazing joints, Adhesive joints, Bolt joints
Explanation of having a sense of professional and ethical responsibility
Introduction of national and international standard and quality organizations. Definition of Standard and Quality.
Explanation for students to be entrepreneurial and self-confident
Providing information about the national and global dimensions of engineering service
Seminar on examples of engineering applications in our country
Visiting an industrial organization and observing engineering applications on site.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 50% for in-term work and 50% for the final exam. In-term work consists of a Mid-term Exam (80%) and a Quiz (20%).
bibliography: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Robert Rizza, Prentice Hall.
